# @stll/text-search

Multi-engine text search orchestrator for Node.js,
Bun, and the Stella browser/WASM stack.

## Routing

- literals -> Aho-Corasick
- regex -> RegexSet
- fuzzy patterns -> FuzzySearch
- large alternations -> isolated RegexSet instance

## API

```ts
import { TextSearch } from "@stll/text-search";

const search = new TextSearch([
  "literal",
  /\bregex\b/,
  { pattern: "Novák", distance: 1, name: "person" },
]);

search.findIter("literal Novak")
search.isMatch("literal Novak")
search.whichMatch("literal Novak")
search.replaceAll("literal Novak", ["x", "y"])
```

## Browser package

Use `@stll/text-search-wasm` in browser builds.
The `./vite` export excludes the Stella WASM
packages from Vite dep pre-bundling so loader
relative paths remain valid.
